purpose: Fail-closed status and evidence checklist for independent review of DF-M0-008 and DF-M0-009; this record grants no production authority.

source_evidence.review_corrections_scope: Post-review clarification/corrections to FFI, performance, grid metadata, SSH/dependency provenance, distribution counts, GRDB provenance, SPDX PURLs, scanner reconstruction, credential-lease contract and packet preflight; no production authority.

scope_sources.composition_note: The correction commit descends from the DF-M0-009 sibling through the packet baseline, incorporates the pinned DF-M0-008 report/data content, and records review corrections; it is not represented as a merge of the DF-M0-008 commit.

explicit_exclusions: production dependency, UI, database or release authority
planning_preflight.claim_limit: Structural and traceability preflight only; sibling-source task completion is deliberately excluded and no external acceptance or executable behavior is proven.

review_invariants: The evidence author, an agent, a scanner, or a risk owner cannot fill an independent reviewer slot on its own behalf.
Concur means the reviewer agrees with the current fail-closed or conditional record; it does not approve a production dependency, capability, implementation, release, license, or safety exception.
Every changes_required or defer result keeps the affected definition of done false and records an owner plus revisit trigger before closure.

Legal advice, private contact data, signatures, credentials, database data, and privileged analysis are not committed; only a non-privileged disposition summary and counsel-held reference may be recorded.

No review result can override a current advisory, missing exact identity, missing executable evidence, unsupported capability, database-safety invariant, or separate implementation-authorization gate.

tasks.scope: Dependency adoption dossiers, candidate inventory, prototype SPDX, policy dry run, and current reject/defer outcomes.

required_evidence: Confirm 13 unique candidate dispositions and the 0 approve / 10 defer / 3 reject summary.
Confirm five candidates lack exact identity while seven lack a full package graph; do not collapse those facts.
Reconstruct named historical locks/resolution and verify raw hashes, package counts, source policy, product-size gaps, and re-entry ownership.
Confirm the reviewed record does not add a manifest, inherit spike code, or claim product/runtime evidence.
required_reviews.scope_limit: Concurrence accepts the engineering record only; every future exact source still needs its own adoption and integration change.

required_evidence: Verify multi-source advisory policy and the RustSec/repository blind spot for GHSA-m65r-rprj-r5rg.
Confirm exact russh 0.62.4, the tested system OpenSSH/native -J path, and exact ssh2/libssh2 source remain rejected.
Review provenance, source allowlist, SBOM relationship reachability, advisory response ownership, disable path, and secret/logging gates.
Confirm a clean scanner or task-level review cannot override an authoritative affected range or missing runtime evidence.
required_reviews.scope_limit: Concurrence is not a security approval for any deferred candidate, SSH capability, updater, telemetry SDK, or release artifact.

required_evidence: Review exact license files, copyright and bundled/transitive notices for selected identities; record unresolved identities as defer.
Review commercial redistribution and attribution posture for native, cryptographic, framework, updater, SDK/service, and OS-provided components.
Keep final DataForge license, Community/Pro terms, privacy/DPA terms, and legal advice outside any fabricated engineering conclusion.
Record only a non-privileged result summary and a counsel-controlled reference when appropriate.
required_reviews.scope_limit: Concurrence with dossier structure is not final product-license text or blanket approval of unselected/future versions.

closure_rules: All three required review slots have a non-pending result from an independent qualified reviewer.
Every changes_required or defer result has been resolved or remains an explicit blocker with owner and revisit trigger.
Candidate-level identities, notices, advisories, runtime evidence, and dispositions are updated without converting unknown facts to approve.
The task definition of done remains false until its ADR/report are updated from reviewer evidence; external review alone does not enable production adoption.

tasks.scope: Five low-fidelity wireframes, shared focus/accessibility/safety contract, 12 tracked actions, and M1/M2 verification ownership.

required_evidence: Disposition hierarchy, terminology, consequences, unavailable capability language, and all 12 actions.
Confirm current direct connection, production/read-only context, result-limit language, and unknown-outcome behavior match product intent.
Confirm static review and owning M1/M2 executable gates remain separate.
Review information hierarchy, native control intent, focus/default behavior, pane collapse, resizing, and localization reflow.
Confirm the artifact remains low fidelity, original, and not a pixel copy of another product.
Assign any unresolved visual/interaction decision an owner and executable revisit trigger.
Review forward/reverse focus, modal entry/return, errors, announcements, keyboard parity, logical grid/editor semantics, and manual VoiceOver plan.
Review Light/Dark, Increase Contrast, Differentiate Without Color, Reduce Motion, larger text, and non-color safety traits.
Confirm metadata/static review is not represented as executable Accessibility Inspector or VoiceOver evidence.
Review production/read-only target truth, destructive consequence, canonical preview digest binding, typed confirmation, and stale revalidation.
Review transaction/pending-edit close, unknown outcome, no auto-commit/retry, and non-dangerous defaults.
Confirm cancellation outcome is separate from execution outcome and connectionClosed never implies server stop or rollback.
Confirm SSH remains unavailable and direct test/connect paths omit SSH phases and host-key results.

Confirm database authentication method is separate from Keychain storage and review the provisional unstored-secret contract: sole ConnectionAttempt owner, non-renewable deadline at the earlier of action timeout or 60 seconds, all terminal/cancel/close revocation triggers, denied post-revocation access, and explicitly best-effort cleanup rather than guaranteed zeroization.
Review same-path keyboard/pointer safeguards, no color-only warning, no insecure bypass, and no secret exposure in help/error/announcement text.

closure_rules: All five required review slots have a non-pending result from an independent qualified reviewer.
All 12 action dispositions, owners, and revisit triggers are updated from reviewer evidence.
Any requested artifact change is applied and re-reviewed without claiming runtime proof.
Static closure does not authorize production UI; M1 and M2 require separate implementation requests and executable owning-milestone evidence.

safe_next_step: Provide this packet and the pinned source evidence to independent reviewers; record only their attributable non-privileged dispositions, then update the source ADRs/reports without weakening any unresolved gate.
